about_short_description.short_description: Karmen is a fintech offering online non-dilutive funding for growth, working capital, and invoice factoring to digital businesses.

product.name: Karmen Short-term Loan
product.description: A short-term loan product offering financing from 1 to 24 months with funds delivered within 48 hours through a fully online process, without processing fees or guarantees.

product.name: Karmen Factor
product.description: A factoring solution that finances B2B customer invoices without requiring the transfer of receivables, allowing businesses to maintain control over client relationships while receiving funds within 48 hours.

product.name: Revenue Based Financing (RBF)
product.description: A non-dilutive financing model where companies receive capital upfront in exchange for a percentage of future revenues, with repayments adjusted based on monthly performance.

product.name: Supplier Payment Financing
product.description: A financing service that allows businesses to pay suppliers immediately while preserving their cash flow by accessing funds quickly.

product.name: Inventory Financing
product.description: A financing solution that provides funds within 48 hours to finance company stock, with repayments aligned to sales performance.

product.name: Marketing Budget Financing
product.description: A financing option to fund marketing and customer acquisition campaigns, with repayments linked to the return on investment generated by these campaigns.
